Hello, Adventurers.



As you are aware, the recent Global BSOD event affected a lot of computer networks, our servers included.

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience this may cause, and we appreciate your support.

notes.title: Important Notice Regarding the Recent System Exploit Issue
notes.content:
Important Notice Regarding the Recent System Exploit Issue

 

Hello,

This is the Ragnarok Online management team.

We would like to inform you about the recent issue that occurred in game.

 

Details of the issue:

We have discovered that items and zeny were acquired unfairly through unauthorized activities by a certain number of accounts.

 

Action taken:
	System vulnerability correction 
We have applied a new build to prevent the issue during normal weekly maintenance on Tuesday, February 20, 2024.
	 Affected accounts
Permanent suspension of all accounts that exploited the system vulnerabilities.
	Affected items and Zeny
Thorough investigation and recovery of all items and Zeny from related accounts.

 

However, due to necessary care and time required to track the movement of both Zeny and the items, there are a number of accounts that are still temporarily suspended at the moment.

Please understand that due to the large amount of data being investigated, this process will take some time.

 

Furthermore, we have confirmed that the above issue does not occur during normal gameplay unless the user performs very specific odd behavior to perform the exploit.

Please be careful not to get involved with suspicious transactions or characters.

If you feel your account might be affected by this issue, please kindly contact the support team.

 

Additionally, since this issue was occurring in many other regions as well, we were unable to provide further details until the fix was implemented in all service areas.

Lastly, continued periodic and close inspections of the game system will be performed.

We will do our best to prevent this issue from happening in the future.

We apologize for the confusion and inconvenience caused to our users.

 

Thank you

Ragnarok Online Team

June 24th, 12:00PM - 6:00PM PDT

Hey Folks,

We will share more details in this week's Good Afternoon thread, but we have a few changes coming to our maintenance schedule for July. We are moving to a bi-weekly update plan for both RT and RO1. There will be weekly maintenances, but the first maintenance will be solely for server restarts and contain no content updates. The second week will be focused on applying more content, bug fixes, and changes. The reason for doing this is to allow for more time to properly test and implement events and schedules.

Currently, we are working on upgrading our testing regime to catch issues, but doing so will require a longer QA process.

On July 8th, RT will be receiving the Popcorn Festa and the systems update. This means guild emblems will be reset on RT on July 8th. After the update, guilds will be able to apply animated emblems. More details will come for this patch at that time.

notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/m8AcA4T.png
April 22nd, 2:00PM - 6:00PM PDT

Hey Folks,
 
Since we are removing Corridor of Phantom this week, I wanted to thank everyone who participated in testing this event. We will be editing the flowers to allow them to be sold to NPCs. We are currently reviewing the data gathered from the event and will be sharing that, along with the feedback in this thread (Link), with the studio tonight.
 
Overall, we see the main player feedback had several themes.

[olist]
 Current Map Settings had a mixed response. It is very unfun to die at map spawn.
 In general, rewards were not satisfying for effort and resources invested. Solo or as a group.
 High Tier Rewards were so rare that few, if any, players were aware of them.
 Balance concerns continue (This will be reflected in log data we gathered)
[/olist]
Please continue to share your feedback and replay files with us over the next few days so we can provide as much information to the studio as we can.

notes.title: Ragnarok Online 12 Days of Christmas Raffle Giveaway!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4461611/e0b12385db2801295a6727cac03b1a355f9531f1.jpg
 

Ragnarok Online
12 Days of Christmas Raffle Giveaway!

We're ringing in the holiday season with a raffle event unlike any other!
Hold onto your hats, folks, we've got some cool prizes for you to win!
Starting Thursday, December 14, we'll be drawing raffle prizes every day for 12 days straight!


Here's how it works:

Each day, we will draw a total of 31 daily prizes from a pool of qualified players
15 winners will receive the Costume of the Day
15 winners will receive a code for 500 WPE
1 lucky winner will receive the Daily Big Prize
At the end of the event, we will draw from all qualifying entries over the course of the event to pick one Grand Prize Winner!

 
How to Enter:
 
Gaining entries into the daily raffle is easy! All you have to do is qualify in one of two ways:

1 Daily Entry for having VIP active
1 Entry per 100 Kafra Points spent (per day)

That's all! As long as you meet those qualifications on any given day during the event, you automatically have an entry into the raffle and have a shot at winning the prizes!
 

Daily Prizes
 
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4461611/988564d0ed16c4fd995709f40b619e05eefd8213.png
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4461611/0e21d43816706d38ef4c959c4a3763f85944571d.png


Grand Prize
After the event is finished on December 25, we'll pool together all valid entries that existed during the eventand choose one at random to receive our Grand Prize! 
 
Grand Prize: 
Ragnarok-Themed Bottle & Towel Set
AND A custom watercolor painting of your character done by JelloShaker! *
* PG-13, waist-up only, 6x6 inches. To be delivered February 2018.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4461611/4a8dab111a605bea469248dd6839617581394a3e.png

 
Event Details

The event will start on Thursday, December 15 and end on Monday, December 25.
To meet the KP qualifications for the daily raffle, KP must be purchased on the same day. 
Example:

100 KP spent on Day 2 = 1 entry for Day 2 raffle
200 KP spent on Day 3 = 2 entries for Day 3 raffle
However, all those entries will count toward the final drawing for the Grand Prize!


Grand Prize drawing will pull from all entries during the event period.
Users may only win one Grand Prize and One Daily Big Prize during the event.
Physical goods (such as the Daily Big Prizes and the Grand Prize) can only be shipped to Canada and continental United States. Should you win one of these prizes from outside the shipping area, you will be given two options:

Pay the shipping costs to receive the physical goods
Receive an alternate prize:

3000 WPE as Grand Prize
1000 WPE as Daily Big Prize




Daily Big Prize winners and Grand Prize winners will be contacted via email from community@warpportal.com for shipping information. Please add this email address to your contact list to ensure you receive it if and when the time comes!

notes.title: Tomb of Honor Update Lands!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4461611/ebef5d815639fd88adda1d70c9aea75067738e1e.jpg


Introducing Tomb of Honor!

This latest edition to the Bio Labs, Tomb of Honor is Ragnarok Online's highest level dungeon, reserved only for the strongest and bravest of adventurers. If you're up to the challenge, you will be rewarded with exhilirating battles and epic rewards!

Learn more about this update by checking out any of the active links below!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4461611/6f0bb0fe4f4238a71b5540b54c4964b04c19a019.png

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4461611/729b4ae60f3ba002c6dff67727c29b730e86aa26.png

In the slums of Lighthalzen, Ohno Tohiro discovered something strange.
It was a crevice situated in an unassuming part of the village. Although the town was no stranger to oddities, the crevice that emitted strange sounds was new. Curious, Ohno Tohiro ventured inside... and immediately scrambled back out. Terrified of what he had seen, he told an adventuring friend of his, who also ventured into the strange crevice.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4461611/ed8a93304ea85e2478ba67f2f1baa47c07841be5.jpg

A few days later, the adventurer emerged from the crevice badly injured, but alive - and loaded with mysterious, powerful items. Word of his time in the mysterious crevice spread, and soon more adventurers and mercenaries began showing up in hopes of gaining such riches. Unfortunately, they never returned. As quickly as it rose in popularity, the crevice began to grow quieter, with only rumors of its horrors and riches surrounding it.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4461611/d273c0f4d6f81fef4194f8c713e853bdde7aeab0.jpg

Nowadays, Ohno Tohiro can be found at the the entrance to the crevice, claiming ownership over it due to his discovery. His experience with the place has made him wary, and he'll only let in adventurers in exchange for zeny, or strangely enough, research papers. Rumors say that the monsters within have slowly taken the shape of other people, and there are whispers of an old biomedical research lab somehow involved. The crevice is open to only the strongest adventurers eager to test their might, explore new places, and find powerful treasures.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4461611/ebef5d815639fd88adda1d70c9aea75067738e1e.jpg


Introducing Tomb of Honor!

This latest edition to the Bio Labs, Tomb of Honor is Ragnarok Online's highest level dungeon, reserved only for the strongest and bravest of adventurers. If you're up to the challenge, you will be rewarded with exhilirating battles and epic rewards!

Learn more about this update by checking out any of the active links below!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4461611/6f0bb0fe4f4238a71b5540b54c4964b04c19a019.png

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4461611/729b4ae60f3ba002c6dff67727c29b730e86aa26.png

In the slums of Lighthalzen, Ohno Tohiro discovered something strange.
It was a crevice situated in an unassuming part of the village. Although the town was no stranger to oddities, the crevice that emitted strange sounds was new. Curious, Ohno Tohiro ventured inside... and immediately scrambled back out. Terrified of what he had seen, he told an adventuring friend of his, who also ventured into the strange crevice.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4461611/ed8a93304ea85e2478ba67f2f1baa47c07841be5.jpg

A few days later, the adventurer emerged from the crevice badly injured, but alive - and loaded with mysterious, powerful items. Word of his time in the mysterious crevice spread, and soon more adventurers and mercenaries began showing up in hopes of gaining such riches. Unfortunately, they never returned. As quickly as it rose in popularity, the crevice began to grow quieter, with only rumors of its horrors and riches surrounding it.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4461611/d273c0f4d6f81fef4194f8c713e853bdde7aeab0.jpg

Nowadays, Ohno Tohiro can be found at the the entrance to the crevice, claiming ownership over it due to his discovery. His experience with the place has made him wary, and he'll only let in adventurers in exchange for zeny, or strangely enough, research papers. Rumors say that the monsters within have slowly taken the shape of other people, and there are whispers of an old biomedical research lab somehow involved. The crevice is open to only the strongest adventurers eager to test their might, explore new places, and find powerful treasures.

Hello everybody! A brief announcement from our team with a few updates.

Compensation Events!

- Starting today, we're going to be doing a 25% EXP + Drops Extra event until 8/10. Classic server will receive the same from 8/10 - 8/17.

Steam users will have it automatically inserted once it starts

Have a great weekend everybody!

notes.title: Special Event - Share the Banquet with Ragnarok Online!
notes.content:
http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/05/800w_ShareBanquet.jpgShare the Banquet with Ragnarok Online
Get ready for Episode 16.1 - Banquet for Heroes with a month of sharing & rewards! 
May 1 to June 1
 
All aboard the hype train! Get ready to usher in Ragnarok Online's latest update, 16.1 - Banquet for Heroes! From May 1 to June 1, journey across the internet to connect with Ragnarok Online for the chance to earn incredible bonuses for all the servers, as well as the chance to win our ultimate Grand Prize! 

 Your Quest 
Log in using Facebook, Twitter, Twitch, or email and complete one or more of the tasks below to earn entries. Every task you complete counts as an entry toward the Grand Prize raffle as well as the server-wide rewards, so make sure to use a valid email address to be eligible for the Grand Prize! 

 The Grand Prize 
Every task you complete in your quest counts as one entry into a raffle to win the following: 
30 Days of VIPChoice of any one (1) costume item previously or currently sold in the Cash ShopTwo (2) Adventurer's Banquet Boxes (contents listed in server rewards below)Choice of three (3) different Pet Tames 
At the end of the campaign, five (5) winners will be contacted through email to receive the Grand Prize, so make sure you enter using a valid email address!

 Rewards for All 
When Midgardians work together, everyone wins! Every task completed for the campaign not only counts toward the Grand Prize raffle, but also toward server-wide rewards for all of Rune-Midgard! Gather your companions and rally the realm - there are prizes to be won!
Server-Wide Prizes Include:

2,000 Shares
+25% EXP and +10% Drops bonus on all servers for duration of campaign 

4,000 Shares
+50% EXP and +20% Drops Bonus on all servers for duration of campaign 

6,000 Shares﻿
NPC Giveaway: Rare Pet Tame grab bag, for one week 

8,000 Shares

notes.title: Episode 15.2: Lost Memories Update Overview
notes.content:
Episode 15.1 and 15.2 introduces a new area to explore and three new instanced dungeons to Ragnarok Online.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4461611/6ee397dd34cde69748583fbdf7a05e17a880bfcf.png
Verus City
Battle your way through the ruins of the lost city of Verus and help the expedition discover the lost history of this ruined city.

Under Bunker
Something had gone terribly wrong in this bunker. Brave the undead and hostile robots and work your way to the last room.

Charleston Factory
Charleston needs you! Help her recover replacement parts so that she may repair herself. Adventurers who are able to assist will find themselves rewarded with equipment from the Charleston Factory.

Central Laboratory
Travel to the past to witness the disaster that destroyed this lab. If you survive perhaps you will be able to bring some souvenirs back with you.

Last Room
Assist a group of adventurers in discovering what happened to the last of the survivors that sheltered in the Under Bunker. Make sure to hold onto any 'intact machine components' found within as the adventurer 'Fruit' is looking to trade some equipment for them.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4461611/85983a818db468052ecc7662056624194f685f88.jpg

Crimson Weapon System Update Overview
Monsters from all over the world of Rune Migard have had their inventories checked and equipment updated. Hunt these monsters to find the new powerful Crimson Weapons. Each Crimson Weapon comes with an embedded charm that causes elemental type damage when the weapon is wielded.

Weapon Elemental Charms:
Fire
Earth
Wind
Water
Shadow
Holy
Neutral

notes.title: Steam Login issues *resolved*
notes.content:
Greetings everyone. We received reports over the weekend that the Steam sign on and overlay weren't working properly. This meant manual logins and not being able to purchase points. We have investigated this issue and as of 2:15pm today we have a solution.

1. Please start the game and let it patch fully. Once it has done so exit out of the patcher and restart the game through steam

2. When you start the game a second time it will fix the issue and the single sign on for RO's Steam client will work properly. 

Thank you very much for your patience.

-[Battle Instructor] NPC will now teleport you directly to South Prontera Field, so it doesn't take so much walking to get to the fighting. There will be a copy of that NPC added to South Prontera field to teleport players back to the Academy. 

Classic
-Nifflheim spotlight continues for one more week, Moscovia spotlight begins next week
-Prepping Moscovia for implementation next week
-Kafras returned to normal
-Fixed Payon direct warp when going from the training grounds
-Working on New Classic Training grounds
-Working on God Item and Guild Dungeon 5 project
